• MAX_SIZE_STACK: when using this allocator there is the intention to allocate a
fixed-size chunk on the stack. Memory on the stack always needs to be con-
strained in terms of the maximum size. In other words, there is hardly any case
where an unbounded amount of memory should be allocated on the stack.
• MAX_SIZE_DATASEGMENT: when using this allocator there is the intention to al-
locate a fixed-size chunk in the data segment.
